mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a comfortable temperature of 62 degrees over at Reddan Soccer Park.

The City of Verona is highlighting two major infrastructure efforts. First, you can join the Adopt A Storm Drain program to help prevent local flooding by keeping debris out of our sewers. Second, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is entering its second phase, with work on utility lines and concrete sidewalks currently underway.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Later this week, you can check out live music at Paddy Mac's and Bailey's Run, or enjoy Thursday night activities at ART House 360.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from last Thursday, where officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Culver's is currently open and serving up the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day until they close at 10 PM tonight.
